essence: The eastern direction is established before the thread is stretched for circle construction.
The procedure halves the established measure and marks middle, east, and west points.
Marking follows the established amount, with thread and twin compass and fish joints for south and north.
A method and an alternative are given for south-north alignment by thread.
Marking runs from prior marks and east; a long thread is placed in the fish middle toward south and north.
